enables: wayfinding: a reliable public content read surface (uuid-or-id) complements the agent-readable read side the anchor catalog publishes
purpose_context: Resolve why GET /story/{uuid} 404s: the canonical public content path is numeric-id keyed, not uuid. Decide and unify the canonical public identifier end-to-end, and clarify the policy-less published-content render path, while holding the published/anonymous access boundaries.
